short_release_notes:
Apollo Passive Receive 1.0.0 Build 93 for Linux ARM64 adds guarded managed-release adoption for enrolled source installations and retains receiver provenance and server reporting authority.

This is a managed-update package. KA9Q, SDRplay and RTL runtime tools are not bundled. It is not a fresh installer. Installing the successor and enabling Live reporting remain separate operations.

Source: b2be587844b207202c210cb90476a82e4d7aedc5
Qualification includes actual ARM64 executable startup, Local Only and KA9Q/RSP1B provenance checks, Pi/archive tests, protected adoption, normal update, rollback, interruption and authority rejection tests.
